# Distractor length balance log

Scope: knowledge checks in `curriculum/courses` and `curriculum/shared` (learner files). Only distractor strings in `knowledgeChecks[].options` were rewritten. Correct options, `correctIndex` values and rationales were not changed by this pass.

Flag rule: a check is flagged when its correct option is more than 1.3 times the mean distractor length, or any distractor is more than 1.3 times the correct option length. Rewritten distractors target 0.8 to 1.2 times the correct option length (aim 0.85 to 1.15). Length ratio = option length in characters divided by the correct option's length.

## Result

| Measure | Before (2,831 checks) | After (same check IDs, 2,830 still present) |
|---|---|---|
| Flagged | 2,358 | 2 (both skipped, see below) |
| Correct option more than 1.3 times the mean distractor | 2,210 | 0 |
| Any distractor more than 1.3 times the correct option | 148 | 2 |
| Correct option strictly longer than every distractor | 2,390 (84.4%) | 1,322 (46.7%) |

Changed: 2,353 checks in 889 files, 5,631 option strings rewritten (5,633 log rows; two C17-L04-K03 options were rewritten twice). Every changed file parses as JSON. The checker (`python3 -I /home/claude/work/check.py`) reports problemCount 0 after the run.

Note on the after figures: the correct option is still the longest in about half of the checks. The flag rule only corrects outliers beyond the 1.3 threshold, so the strict-longest rate is not expected to reach 25%.

## Not changed

- `F15-L02-K01` (`shared/induction/F15-L02.json`): during the run, another agent changed the answer key from option 2 to option 0 ("Stop and tell the supervisor before going further"), which matches the rationale. Its options were not edited by this pass. It is now within the threshold (correct option 49 characters; distractors 37, 43 and 60).
- `S12-L03-K01` (`shared/quality/S12-L03.json`): the answer key points at option 0 ("Whether the cleaner who did the work is well liked"), which is not a valid check. Options left as they were; the key needs review.
- `MP-07-K01` (`shared/operations/MP-07.json`): all options are 3 to 4 characters, and the rationale names the "222%" distractor. Changing it would make the rationale wrong, so it was left as is. Length ratio 4/3 = 1.33, still flagged.
- `PVB-06-K03` (`shared/pool/PVB-06.json`): already balanced at the end of the run. Its options and key were changed by a separate PVB-06 edit outside this log.
- `property-maintenance-L03-K01`: removed from its learner file and assessment key by another agent during the run. Not measured after.
- `C17-L04-K03`: after the first rewrite, another edit changed the correct option (now 67 characters). The two distractors I had written (20 and 19 characters) were rebalanced afterwards. See the post-run rows in the log.

Checks added to the course and shared files after the baseline by other edits: 396 in the current measure. 322 of them are currently flagged. They were not in this pass's scope and were not rebalanced.
